# Phangan Links

> A curated link directory for life on Koh Phangan, Thailand.

Canonical website: https://phangan-links-steel.vercel.app/

Links checked 2026-11-03. Public previews do not prove group activity or joining availability. Independent directory; not an official island authority.

## Living

- [PhanganBase](https://phanganbase.com/): Monthly rentals and longer stays around the island.
- [Housing](https://chat.whatsapp.com/CYhHq7oLQ3OForRLPrTAF3?s=cl&p=i&mlu=0): WhatsApp group for homes and housemates.
- [Buy & sell](https://chat.whatsapp.com/IxaZUt2iE3SJypdLbVHMu5?mode=gi_t): Buy and sell secondhand items on WhatsApp.
- [Ride rentals](https://chat.whatsapp.com/C9itRKbN8DU1S4YhsfqM1G?mode=gi_t): WhatsApp group for scooter and vehicle rentals.
- [Upcycle & recycle](https://chat.whatsapp.com/DQAx4fPIRZO2LJYDBFb4o0?mode=gi_c): WhatsApp group for reusing, repairing and recycling.
- [Recycling drop-off points](https://ecothailand.org/recyclesites/): Where to recycle, and what goes where.
- [Inner Space coworking](https://innerspace.place/): Coworking space and community near Srithanu.
- [Markets & walking streets](https://kohphangan.com/koh-phangan-markets/): A local guide to food markets and walking streets.

## Community

- [Digital nomads](https://chat.whatsapp.com/CYoXgCPgIQ5IyFlYvHyBGC?mode=gi_t): WhatsApp group for remote workers and entrepreneurs.
- [Pets](https://chat.whatsapp.com/BR2n99DQotp9dqrQYfaiO0?mode=gi_t): WhatsApp group for island pets and their owners.
- [Parents](https://chat.whatsapp.com/JsvFtnA05CoEP17m8awBBg?mode=gi_t): WhatsApp group for families on Koh Phangan.
- [Leftover food](https://chat.whatsapp.com/LwCyi6SQLZyLlV4YjXgEJF?mode=gi_c): Share surplus food through the local WhatsApp group.
- [PACS animal care](https://www.pacsthailand.com/): Care for island strays, adoption & volunteering.
- [EcoThailand](https://ecothailand.org/interns-and-volunteers/): Local environmental projects and volunteering.
- [Shaolin arts](https://chat.whatsapp.com/FYAA1prpdMV4seE3cp9ObT): The island’s Shaolin arts community on WhatsApp.
- [Volleyball](https://chat.whatsapp.com/Dsf7SWh1uyZ2TuVrpVvwuP): Find local volleyball games through the WhatsApp group.
- [Trading & economics](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GBoE51xlL4h25Yu6NC3Mu3): WhatsApp group for local trading and economics discussions.
- [More community groups](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1H18auNoNBECzqIIS6eNHBoSP8o41p0UgezX4542DP6w/edit?usp=sharing): A community-maintained directory of island groups.

## Explore

- [Todo.Today](https://todo.today/koh-phangan/): Classes, workshops and events on Koh Phangan.
- [Parties](https://chat.whatsapp.com/LJ8534IoLEC5YyLuvDCNwK?mode=gi_t): WhatsApp group for parties and nightlife.
- [Events & promotions](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GEJgZ1HkQLW0uPAV77uPG6?mode=gi_t): WhatsApp group for community events and local offers.
- [Hiking](https://chat.whatsapp.com/DvsEn3NkD6a6UusFXNN6ok?mode=gi_c): Find walking groups and hiking companions on WhatsApp.
- [COREsea](https://coresea.com/): Marine conservation, research & learning by the sea.
- [Explore the island](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Ko-Phangan/358): Beaches, nature & island sights from Tourism Thailand.
- [Hiking routes](https://kohphangan.com/koh-phangan-hiking/): Trail notes for jungle walks and viewpoints.
- [KPG Comedy](https://chat.whatsapp.com/LgkYObLpk6p0VgunwH3Oj2): Comedy nights and workshops. WhatsApp group.
- [One Yoga](https://oneyogathailand.com/drop-in-schedule/): Drop-in yoga and meditation at a beachfront campus.
- [Orion](https://www.orionhealing.com/weekly-schedule/): Weekly schedule of yoga classes and workshops.
- [Samma Karuna](https://www.sammakaruna.org/): Explore yoga, meditation & workshops by the sea.

## Essentials

- [Visa questions](https://chat.whatsapp.com/IdBv9yNO5Ha55RRLeaPjnl): Community visa discussions on WhatsApp.
- [Lost & found](https://chat.whatsapp.com/DhnnjBbYi2Y9GNyN3TC7J3?mode=gi_t): Report lost items or share what you’ve found on WhatsApp.
- [Lomprayah ferries](https://www.lomprayah.com/): Ferry routes, tickets & connections to the mainland.
- [Seatran Discovery](https://www.seatrandiscovery.com/): Ferry tickets and transfers between the islands and mainland.
- [Weather · TMD](https://www.tmd.go.th/en/weather/province/surat-thani): Official weather forecasts for Surat Thani province.
- [Thailand arrival card](https://tdac.immigration.go.th/arrival-card/): The official, free Thailand Digital Arrival Card portal.

## Machine-readable resources

- [JSON dataset](https://phangan-links-steel.vercel.app/links.json): Every curated destination, category and verification context.
- [Sitemap](https://phangan-links-steel.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
- [Source and research](https://github.com/its-gaib/phangan-links)
